Contributing to ntlpanel

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for helping improve ntlpanel. Bug reports, data-source requests, documentation fixes and code contributions are all welcome.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue at https://github.com/iskakovs/ntlpanel/issues with:

  • what you ran (a minimal reproducible example; the reprex package helps),
  • what you expected and what happened,
  • the output of sessionInfo() and terra::gdal(),
  • the product id and period (for example VJ146A3, 2024-06) if the problem concerns a specific data file.

Never paste your NASA Earthdata token into an issue.

Proposing a change

  1. Open an issue first for anything larger than a typo, so we can agree on the approach.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  3. Follow the existing style: snake_case names, lines of at most 80 characters, roxygen2 documentation with an example and a @return for every exported function.
  4. Add tests with testthat. Tests must run offline: use the fixtures in tests/testthat/helper-fixtures.R or httr2::with_mocked_responses() for anything that would download data.
  5. Run devtools::document(), devtools::test() and devtools::check() before opening the pull request, and add a line to NEWS.md.

Code of conduct

Please note that this project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing to this project you agree to abide by its terms. If the package is accepted by rOpenSci, the rOpenSci Code of Conduct applies.
